sn24.10:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati Asassato loko ti || || Bhagavammūlakā no bhante dhammā || || Rūpe
sn24.10:2.1: kho bhikkhave sati || pa || Viññāṇaṃ niccam aniccaṃ vā ti || || Aniccam bhante || pa || || Api nu tam anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya Asassato loko ti || || No hetam bhante || || Yam pi diṭṭhaṃ sutam mutaṃ viññātam pattam pariyesitam anuvicaritam manasā tam pi niccaṃ va aniccaṃ vāti || || Aniccam bhante || || Dukkham vipariṇāmadhammam api nu tam anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya Asassato loko ti || || No hetam bhante
